$description: Workshopr design tokens in W3C DTCG format. GENERATED from design-system/platform-tokens.css by generate-tokens-dtcg.php — do not edit by hand.

brand.$description: buttons, the mark, fills that carry white text

ink.$description: red text on white (5.02:1), headings, emphasis

line.$description: borders and rules on a soft red fill

soft.$description: chips, soft fills, the underline band

tint.$description: the lightest wash: page bands, hover backgrounds

success.$description: Success status for icons, dots and fills that carry no text. 2.28:1 on white, so success text uses --color-success-ink or --color-success-darker

success-dark.$description: Heavier success icon or border. 3.30:1 on white: large text and icons only

success-light.$description: Mid success tint for fills and glows. Text on it uses --color-success-ink (6.34:1)

success-very-light.$description: Palest success fill, a success row or panel. Text on it uses --color-success-ink (7.0:1)

warning.$description: Warning status for icons, dots and fills that carry no text. 2.15:1 on white, so warning text uses --color-warning-ink

warning-dark.$description: Heavier warning icon or border. 3.19:1 on white: large text and icons only

warning-light.$description: Mid warning tint for fills and borders. Text on it uses --color-warning-ink (5.69:1)

warning-very-light.$description: The highlight fill. Was #FEF3C7 (amber-100) until Sep 2026. Text on it uses --color-warning-ink; --color-warning-darker falls to 4.32:1 and fails AA.

error.$description: Error status for icons, invalid-field borders and fills. 3.76:1 on white, so error text uses --color-error-dark or --color-error-ink

error-dark.$description: Error text on white (4.83:1) and the heavier error border. Only 3.95:1 on --color-error-very-light; use --color-error-ink there

error-light.$description: Mid error tint for fills and the glow round an invalid field. Text on it uses --color-error-ink (5.57:1)

error-very-light.$description: Palest error fill, an error row or panel. Text on it uses --color-error-ink (6.6:1)

info.$description: Info status for icons and fills that carry no text. 3.68:1 on white, so info text uses --color-info-dark

info-dark.$description: Info text and icons on white (5.17:1). Only 4.24:1 on --color-info-very-light; use --color-info-strong there

info-light.$description: Mid info tint for fills and borders

info-very-light.$description: Palest info fill, an info row or panel. Text on it uses --color-info-strong (7.15:1)

ink-muted.$description: Stone hue (25deg, 5% saturation) at the lightest step that clears AA on every surface it sits on: 5.39:1 on white, 5.16:1 on --bg-page, 5.04:1 on --bg-paper, 4.80:1 on --card-bg, 4.54:1 on --bg-paper-dark / --header-bg. Was #78716C (4.28:1 on --card-bg) until Oct 2026

ink-faint.$description: ⚠️ 2.52:1 on white, 2.41:1 on --bg-page — decorative only, never essential text

primary-on-white.$description: 5.02:1 — use instead of --mainsite-primary for text on white

ink-faint-accessible.$description: 5.39:1 on white, 4.80:1 on --card-bg: use instead of --color-ink-faint for essential text

success-ink.$description: Dark emerald — text on success backgrounds

warning-ink.$description: Dark amber — text on warning backgrounds

warning-ink-dark.$description: Darker amber — headings on warning backgrounds

error-ink.$description: Dark red — text on error backgrounds

light.$description: Mid exercise fill and border; clipped into sRGB, so about 4% less saturated than its red. Text on it uses --color-info-strong (6.18:1)

very-light.$description: Palest exercise fill, an exercise row or panel. Text on it uses --color-info-strong (7.23:1)

light.$description: Mid icebreaker fill and border. Text on it uses --color-success-ink (5.54:1)

very-light.$description: Palest icebreaker fill, an icebreaker row or panel. Text on it uses --color-success-ink (6.42:1)

page-warm.$description: Slightly warmer than --bg-page, used for immersive detail pages

warm-muted.$description: Warm muted background, midpoint between --bg-muted and --bg-page

paper.$description: Standard grid/paper overlay background used in Planner, DNA, and Academy

paper-dark.$description: Darker grid lines, panels, and borders for paper backgrounds

dark.$description: Headings and primary text: titles, labels, the main line of a card. 15.3:1 on white

default.$description: Body copy and descriptions. 7.66:1 on white

muted.$description: Secondary text: meta lines, hints, timestamps. AA on every surface: 5.39:1 on white, 5.16:1 on --bg-page, 5.04:1 on --bg-paper, 4.80:1 on --card-bg, 4.54:1 on --bg-paper-dark

faint.$description: Decorative only: placeholders and disabled text, never information. 2.52:1 on white; prefers-contrast: more swaps in the accessible value

interactive.$value: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), box-shadow var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), opacity var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), visibility var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default)

spring.$description: Organic settle — pure deceleration, does NOT overshoot despite the name

fade-out.$description: Duration and easing for an exit fade, as in transition: opacity var(--animate-fade-out). See motion.md

slide-up.$description: Duration and spring easing for an entrance that rises into place. See motion.md

scale.$description: Duration and spring easing for a scale-in, such as a popover opening. See motion.md

min-sm.$description: Compact tiles and stats: ws_grid min sm. Also the floor a growing ws_cluster item keeps before its row wraps

min-lg.$description: Wide cards with a paragraph or an image: ws_grid min lg

line-color.$description: Standard signature drafting grid-paper overlay line color

xs.$description: Retired for icons: an icon is at least --icon-lg (DESIGN.md §8). Kept only because the native apps mirror it; never size an icon with it

sm.$description: Retired for icons: an icon is at least --icon-lg (DESIGN.md §8). Kept only because the native apps mirror it; never size an icon with it

md.$description: Retired for icons: an icon is at least --icon-lg (DESIGN.md §8). Kept only because the native apps mirror it; never size an icon with it

lg.$description: The smallest an icon is anywhere (DESIGN.md §8), an SVG from icon() or a font glyph

ring-color.$description: The keyboard focus ring. Sky blue on purpose (decision D2): the one non-red accent, so focus is unmistakable. Keep it opaque; forced-colors mode swaps in Highlight

ring-offset.$description: Gap between a control's edge and its focus ring

ring-width.$description: Focus ring thickness; 3px under prefers-contrast: more

ring.$description: The whole ring as one value: outline: var(--focus-ring)

light.$description: White veil over content, lightest: the most of what is underneath shows through

medium.$description: White veil over content, for a frosted panel or a loading cover

heavy.$description: White veil over content, almost opaque

light.$description: Dark scrim behind a panel or drawer, lightest

medium.$description: Dark scrim behind a modal; --modal-backdrop uses it

heavy.$description: Dark scrim, heaviest, for a focus mode that hides the page

shadow-primary-hover.$description: Shadow under a primary ws_button on hover

bg-secondary.$description: Secondary ws_button fill. .ws-btn does not read it; only a Synthesize mockup does

text-secondary.$description: Secondary ws_button text. .ws-btn does not read it; only a Synthesize mockup does

border-secondary.$description: Secondary ws_button border. Nothing reads it yet

bg-ghost.$description: Ghost button fill. .ws-btn does not read it; Sidekick's .sk-btn--ghost does

text-ghost.$description: Ghost button text. .ws-btn does not read it; Sidekick's .sk-btn--ghost does

radius.$description: Button corner radius. .ws-btn does not read it; the planner's .btn (planner/index.php) does

bg.$description: Card surface: warm paper between --bg-paper (#FAF7F2) and --bg-paper-dark (#F0EBE3). White stays for modals, inputs and menus

border.$description: Card border, read by the ws_card family

shadow.$description: Resting card shadow; app card styles read it, .ws-card does not

radius.$description: Card corner radius, read by the ws_card family

placeholder.$description: Input placeholder text: decorative, never the label

ring.$description: Soft glow round a focused input

border.$description: Modal border. Nothing reads it yet

text.$description: ws_badge default text. Nothing reads it yet

border.$description: ws_badge default border. Nothing reads it yet
Toast border. Nothing reads it yet

strong.$description: A divider that has to read clearly, a step darker than the default border

hover.$description: Link colour on hover. Nothing reads it yet

visited.$description: Visited link colour. Nothing reads it yet

grid-gutter.$description: The gutter between page-grid columns, and the gap of .app-page and every .app-grid-N

content-wide.$description: The page grid's full width: the content column of an /app/ view in a 1440 window
